```plato
    // Bridges every hole into the outer ring, left to right. A hole emptied by
    // cleanup, or one whose bridge search escapes, is left out: the first encloses
    // nothing, the second cannot be reached from the boundary.
    BridgeHoles(points: Array<Point2D>, nodes: Buffer<EarClipNode>,
        holeStarts: Array<Integer>): Buffer<EarClipNode>
    {
        var result = nodes;
        var order = points.HolesLeftToRight(holeStarts);
        var free = points.Count;
        var k = 0;
        while (k < order.Count)
        {
            var hole = order[k];
            var holeHead = holeStarts.RingStart(hole + 1)
                .FirstLiveSlot(result, holeStarts.RingEnd(hole + 1, points.Count));
            if (holeHead >= 0)
            {
                var outerHead = 0.FirstLiveSlot(result, holeStarts.RingEnd(0, points.Count));
                var holeSlot = points.LeftmostSlot(result, holeHead);
                var bridgeSlot = points.BridgeSlot(result, outerHead, holeSlot);
                if (bridgeSlot >= 0)
                {
                    result = bridgeSlot.Bridge(result, holeSlot, free);
                    free = free + 2;
                }
            }
            k = k + 1;
        }
        return result;
    }
```
